name: v0.10.0
body:
## Muninn now tells you about new releases

Muninn can check once a day (plus a small random delay) whether a newer **stable** release exists. When there is one, a passive banner names the version and the matching manual upgrade path for your install — AppImage, AUR, `.deb`, tarball/`install.sh` or the releases page — with **Release notes** and **Dismiss**. It never downloads or installs anything.

The check is **on by default** and can be turned off under **Settings › Appearance › Updates**; turning it off makes no request. It sends only `User-Agent: muninn/<version>`, `Accept`, `X-GitHub-Api-Version` and an ETag — no token, vault path, note text, settings or usage data. It runs about daily after a success and backs off from one hour to one day after a failure, staying silent on offline/timeout/error. Details are in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).

## Assets

Eleven files: Linux x86_64/aarch64 tarballs and AppImages, macOS aarch64 tarball, Windows x86_64 zip, both `.deb`s, `install.sh`, `checksums.txt` and the Sigstore bundle. Linux builds keep the glibc 2.39 floor.

## What's Changed
* chore: refresh AUR and site snapshot for 0.9.3 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/270
* feat(update): add the release-check model and GitHub client (#234 core) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/271
* feat(update): show the release banner and settings toggle (#234) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/272
* Release 0.10.0: notify-only update check by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/273
